lines.zh: 我伏低身子窜出去，水花溅开。
lines.en: I dart low and water sprays up.

lines.zh: 四条细腿跑得很快，壳一晃一晃。
lines.en: Four thin legs move fast; my shell rocks.
I leap over a wave.

lines.zh: 湿沙上留下带蹼的脚印。
lines.en: Webbed prints mark the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我贴着海面跑，风把我推着。
lines.en: I run along the sea's skin, pushed by wind.
Small body, absurdly fast.

lines.zh: 我挤进石缝里，又钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze into a crack and out again.
My tail drags a faint line of water.
I keep looking back as I run.
My breath is shallow, but I last.
I clear a reef stone.

lines.zh: 我是不是跑得太前面了。
lines.en: Have I run too far ahead?
I stop and wait a moment.
Then I run again.
Sand clings to my shell.
I shake; it stays.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石头上，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I crouch on a rock, gills opening and closing.
My shell is still soft and pale.

lines.zh: 风从海上吹来，我抬起头。
lines.en: Wind comes off the sea; I raise my head.
I lick the edge of my mouth.
Something moves beneath the sand.
I stare at that spot.

lines.zh: 我趴在礁石下，钳子不动。
lines.en: I lie under the reef, claws still.
I scrape twice with a foreclaw.
Nothing there.
I pull myself in.
This is safer.
A large one calls far away.
That is my source.
I turn my head that way.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛黑得发亮。
lines.en: I look up; my eyes are black and bright.
You are bigger than my shell.
I shrink back a little.
Then I peek out again.

lines.zh: 我从壳沿探出眼柄看你。
lines.en: I poke my eyestalks over my shell rim to look at you.
Your hands hold no weapon.
Then I may come closer.

lines.zh: 我拖着湿脚印靠近半步。
lines.en: I drag my wet footprints half a step closer.
I sniff your boot.
Salty.
I cry out; my shell tilts.
The pain sends me scampering in circles.
I wedge into a reef crack and pant.
A gash opens on my back.
My blood is pale blue.
I do not counter; I run first.
I look back after a few steps.
I bare my teeth.
I am still here.
I make a small sound.
Is it fish? Is it fish?
I lean in very close.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，不是海里的味道。
lines.en: I sniff; it is not from the sea.
But I still want a bite.
I snatch it and run back.
In case you want it back.
It is a little hard.
I chew for a long while.
Sea food tastes better.
But I do not spit it out.
You touch me and I bounce away.

lines.zh: 我翻了个跟头，四脚朝天。
lines.en: I flip over and land on my back.
I get up with a new mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的腿，抬头瞪你。
lines.en: I bump your leg and glare up at you.
I bump it again.
This time on purpose.
You step back.
I have won.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴拍了一下水面。
lines.en: I slap the water with my tail.
Water shakes off my shell.
I am still small.
That is far from me yet.
I still have two molts to get through.
I would rather chase the surf.
I run to the water's edge.
A wave comes; I leap clear.
Another comes; I leap again.
Now this is fun.
I forget what we were on about.
I have run off again.
I bite down on it and nearly topple.
It weighs my neck down.
I drop it after two steps.
I pick it up and go on.
This one is shiny.
I hide it in a crack.
No one will find it.
I nearly forget it myself.
I run back and check.
Still there.
Something moved.
I press my shell flat to the sand.
I fix on that spot.
It's smaller than me, so I move first.
Then there is nothing to fear.
I arch my back.
My shell lifts, making me look bigger.

lines.zh: 我从鳃里挤出一声低鸣。
lines.en: A low note squeezes out of my gills.
It did not run.
Then I move first.
I run circles around it.
Too fast to follow.
I bite from the side.
Then pull back.

lines.zh: 它转过来，我已经在后面。
lines.en: It turns; I am behind it.
My shell butts it once.
It seems dazed.
I do it again.
The waterline is mine.
I push it toward the water.
I leap and bite down.
My teeth are small but many.
I ram with my shell.
My claws rake its hide.
I leap at its face.
It recoils a step.
I follow and hit again.
Then I run off fast.
I watch it from a distance.

lines.zh: 它愣在那儿，我又咬一口。
lines.en: It stands there dazed; I bite again.
I crawl up out of the water.

lines.zh: 我爬上岸，壳缝缠着海草。
lines.en: I crawl ashore with seaweed caught in my shell seams.
This is my first time on land.

lines.zh: 沙子很软，我陷下去一点。
lines.en: The sand is soft; I sink a little.
Salt water runs down the rim of my shell.
The tide withdraws behind me.
I walk a few steps forward.
Then stop and look.
It is brighter here than in the water.
I do not much like it.

lines.zh: 火烧到壳上，烫得我直跳。
lines.en: Fire hits my shell and I hop about.

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下来，滚了一圈。
lines.en: I fall off a rock and roll once.
Water never bothered me.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀得壳都翻过来。
lines.en: The blast flips my shell right over.
It buries in my shell.
A numbness takes me and I cannot move.
Hungry enough to bite stones.
Lightning falls; I curl into a ball.
I am dragged into the dark.
